programme.title: Chuggington
programme.desc: Brewster tries to get busy Action Chugger to play a game of hide-and-seek. But in his zest to prove he is best friends with Action Chugger, Brewster puts his relationships with Koko and Wilson on the line.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and the Grape Kids are enjoying flying kites until Evil Pea arrives in her balloon and cuts them down so she can rule the supermarket skies! Supertato and Carrot must climb a display of chopsticks to retrieve the kites from the top. Evil Pea threatens to cut them down again, so Supertato and Carrot turn their kites into hang-gliders and embark on an epic aerial chase with Evil Pea, leading to her bursting her balloon on a chopsticks display sign. Supertato and Carrot land safely on the ground, ready to fly kites again!

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Pando experiment with Bing's toy train on the Fun Fort in the playground. The train is good at going over bridges and brilliant at going down the slide. But when Bing slides it off the roof of the playhouse, the train crashes and breaks. Bing is upset until he realises that the pieces fit together to make something completely different.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing and Sula are performing a puppet show for Flop, Amma and Pando when Coco and Charlie arrive. Coco wants to join in with her Rainbow Fairy Mice. Sula tells a frustrated Bing that you have to be loud when you do a show. But Bing is a little too loud, and when Coco joins the show, Bing's loud Biteysaurus isn't welcome, as he is hurting Sula’s ears!

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's a scorcher of a day. Luckily, Duggee has a big paddling pool. Yippee! First of all, they need help with blowing up the pool and filling it with water. Thank goodness for Ethel the elephant, she can do everything. Time for the Squirrels to have lots of fun. Watch Tag, Betty, Norrie, Happy and Roly and all their animal friends have fun in the pool under the watchful eye of lifeguard Duggee.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Wow, Duggee is clever - he shows the Squirrels how to make a paper boat out of the sheets of his newspaper. And look, it floats! As they all look on in admiration, an army of ants interrupt. They need help to get across to the other side of the pond so they can join a picnic. Happy comes up with a very good idea - to make the ants a big paper boat. Duggee and the Squirrels make the ants a huge paper boat and waft them over to the other side of the pond. Tiny ant-sized hotdogs are their prize.

programme.title: Go Jetters
programme.desc: While Xuli and Kyan brush up on their Vroomster skills, Tala, Lars and Foz help the Academy’s banana crop by removing some vines that were constricting the trees. Nearby, Glitch prepares a picnic for Ubercorn. Tala drops by to deliver some fresh bananas for the picnic, and Foz spots a tiny ant on the fruit. Tala asks her uncle to shrink her, Foz and Lars with his size-ray. The tiny Go Jetters discover the ants will accept them as one of their own if they rub the insects’ smell on them. Now they are no longer a threat, the team follows the ants into their tree. Ubercorn and Glitch tuck into their picnic, but an ant steals the cherry from Glitch’s cake and takes it inside the tree. Unable to fit inside, Glitch uses his size-ray to shrink himself and zooms after the ant. Inside the tree, the ants see Glitch as a threat and start to surround him. He makes a run for it, but they pursue him down the trunk. Glitch demands the Grimbots make him bigger again, but they miss and accidentally blast an ant with the size-ray – supersizing it!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: When Mr Tod's efforts to creep up on the rabbits are thwarted by a noisy song thrush, he cages the bird so that he can ambush Peter and his friends without warning.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: Barnacles and Kwazii investigate a disruption on a nearby reef - a carrier crab and the urchin who lives on its shell just can't seem to get along.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: Everyone wants to win Swoppiton’s hide-and-seek tournament. But Mojo and Bo accidentally break the prize. They need to put it back together without the seeker spotting them!

programme.title: Football Fantastics
programme.desc: Match of the Day is coming to film the Fantastics, but an injured Jaz can't play. Instead, she asks Kassius to film her presenting a short film about the team, hoping to get it on TV.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Today, Justin and his friend go to the library and finish their day with a treat in the library cafe. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble uses his imagination by playing 'library' with the toys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey is running a taxi service. Her first passenger is Businessman Dad, who is in a rush to get to the airport. But with unexpected delays, Dad's in danger of missing his flight!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey’s Father’s Day card has to be perfect, but she can’t decide what to draw.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don’t understand what he’s doing and think it’s funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them ‘why’ is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: On a rare day without patients, Zog and Gadabout can’t wait to unwind - but Pearl can’t stop doctoring! They must help her relax before she bandages every creature in sight.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: The Piris take refuge in grumpy Millie the Squid’s cave during a storm but accidentally damage a painting. Can they find a clever way to fix it before Millie finds out?

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: Rafi and Finn want to read their adventure book at the Bake A Wish Café, but there are too many distractions - even Dash can’t focus! Rafi makes a wish to freeze the café so they can read in peace. At first, it works, but frozen trams, floating crisps and silly surprises keep them busy. When the wish fades, Rafi helps Jake, and the café comes back to life with lots of giggles. Rafi decides the café is too noisy for reading, so she makes a cosy corner in her bedroom instead.

programme.title: Big Lizard
programme.desc: Searching for a vital part of the ship that was lost during their crash-landing, Cosima and Big Lizard find Dunk stuck on a beach. They use science to save the day and make a new friend.

programme.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
programme.desc: An apple tree runs amok. Spidey gets stuck in space.

programme.title: Octonauts: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: The Octonauts must clear a logjam while protecting a family of birds.

programme.title: Knee High Spies
programme.desc: On a midnight mission, the team must stop Silver Paw and Pranksy from stealing Lauchie's tooth.

programme.title: The Weasy Family
programme.desc: The ducklings lose a relay race against the eaglets and are fed up with Weasy for not cheering them on. As Papa Eagle comes to show off, Weasy decides to challenge this pretentious family. It's time to train, but Weasy becomes an unbearable coach.

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: Hank must save the day after Gor-don the Great uses mind control on the other heroes.

programme.title: Small Potatoes
programme.desc: Animated series about a group of singing potatoes. The Small Potatoes visit Spain for a flamenco dancing fiesta.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Rebecca washes all the hats, ready for a silly hat party - but Murphi’s special party hat has shrunk. Although he’s disappointed, it gives Murphi an idea - a clothes peg giraffe. The Mini Monsters are using everyday things to create great makes, and a call comes in on the Magic Monster Mirror from Rebecca’s aunt. Murphi’s mega monster make is a fun woolly head game inspired by scraps of wool delivered by the Recycling Express.

programme.title: My World Kitchen
programme.desc: Meet Orson, our talented cook from the Midlands. Orson is cooking his very special version of bakewell tart for his friends. Some people say that a bakewell tart recipe comes from the Midlands, so Orson's version should be very good. Let's hope his friends like it too! He is using lots of delicious ingredients like raspberry jam and flaked almonds but is really hoping that his friends will like the lemony taste of the tart, as this is his special ingredient. To make things even more exciting, Orson is throwing his friends an afternoon tea party with fancy dress. This is going to be so much fun!

programme.title: Hamza Loves Animals: Africa
programme.desc: A visit from older zebra Bahati leads the baby zebras into mischief. Hamza spots some wild warthogs and takes on a smelly but useful task at the orphanage!

programme.title: Down on the Farm
programme.desc: Storm visits a farm in Scotland to help pick leaves for a delicious salad whilst JB goes to a stud farm in Herefordshire to discover how they look after their horses and foals. Children at a school in Huddersfield show us how to make a hotel for summer bugs, we make burgers for a barbecue and Storm shares a summer poem about flying.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog
programme.desc: It's Waffle's last day at the Brooklyn-Bells' but he still finds time to upset neighbour Mrs Hobbs. Simon hears Waffle speak. Will he finally agree that the family can keep the special dog?

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: It's a very windy day, and the Squirrels want to play outside. What can they do? Duggee knows - he's flying his kite. The Squirrels set about making their own kites to fly. Well done Squirrels! What brilliant flags!

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: As newborn baby sea turtles make their way to the ocean, the Octonauts must steer them clear of a giant wave and hungry predators.

programme.desc: Glitch has attached huge rocket boosters to Grim HQ in an attempt to become the first Grandmaster in space. As he thunders up into the night sky, it looks like he may actually do it this time. Then the boosters splutter to a stop and he crashes back to Earth. Glitch clambers to his feet amongst the wreckage of Grim HQ and demands the Grimbots find him another spaceship. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters arrive at the Seattle Space Needle, a huge spire with a futuristic viewing platform made to look like a flying saucer. Suddenly the ground begins to shake. Kyan thinks it's his stomach, Xuli thinks it's an earthquake, but Foz spots the real cause - Glitch has attached four of his huge rockets to the saucer to turn the Space Needle into a spaceship!

programme.title: Big Lizard

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: At Jamie's final game for Leicester City, he scores his 200th goal for the club - it's a fairytale ending to one of the greatest underdog stories in sporting history. But he's not done with football yet, and the search for his new club begins. As speculation mounts, the Vardys consider offers from clubs all wanting to sign the 38-year-old striker. But none are in England, which forces the family to consider: would they go with Jamie, or stay at home? On deadline day, there is last-minute chaos as Jamie decides between two top clubs, one in Holland and the other in Italy. At the eleventh hour, he takes the Italian job. The Vardys are going to Italy! Determined to stay together as a family unit, Becky flies to Italy to find a house and schools for the kids - but in rainy Milan, nothing goes to plan.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin starts his American adventure with a visit to one of his favourite places in the USA - the Napa Valley. He first drops into one of the best food and drink markets in California before cooking with some delicious local produce at a stunning vineyard - James then gets an exclusive look at the brand-new kitchen at The French Laundry, one of the world's best restaurants, and tours their stunning kitchen garden with chef and owner Thomas Keller. A visit to the Napa Valley wouldn't be complete without blending your own wine, so James makes his own red to bring back home with him - finally, James takes inspiration from Napa's bountiful larder to cook California-inspired food back in the UK.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...

In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: At Jamie's final game for Leicester City, he scores his 200th goal for the club - it's a fairytale ending to one of the greatest underdog stories in sporting history. But he's not done with football yet, and the search for his new club begins. As speculation mounts, the Vardys consider offers from clubs all wanting to sign the 38-year-old striker. But none are in England, which forces the family to consider: would they go with Jamie, or stay at home? On deadline day, there is last-minute chaos as Jamie decides between two top clubs, one in Holland and the other in Italy. At the eleventh hour, he takes the Italian job. The Vardys are going to Italy! Determined to stay together as a family unit, Becky flies to Italy to find a house and schools for the kids - but in rainy Milan, nothing goes to plan.

programme.title: Dickinson's Real Deal

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin starts his American adventure with a visit to one of his favourite places in the USA - the Napa Valley. He first drops into one of the best food and drink markets in California before cooking with some delicious local produce at a stunning vineyard - James then gets an exclusive look at the brand-new kitchen at The French Laundry, one of the world's best restaurants, and tours their stunning kitchen garden with chef and owner Thomas Keller. A visit to the Napa Valley wouldn't be complete without blending your own wine, so James makes his own red to bring back home with him - finally, James takes inspiration from Napa's bountiful larder to cook California-inspired food back in the UK.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin starts his American adventure with a visit to one of his favourite places in the USA - the Napa Valley. He first drops into one of the best food and drink markets in California before cooking with some delicious local produce at a stunning vineyard - James then gets an exclusive look at the brand-new kitchen at The French Laundry, one of the world's best restaurants, and tours their stunning kitchen garden with chef and owner Thomas Keller. A visit to the Napa Valley wouldn't be complete without blending your own wine, so James makes his own red to bring back home with him - finally, James takes inspiration from Napa's bountiful larder to cook California-inspired food back in the UK.

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: At Jamie's final game for Leicester City, he scores his 200th goal for the club - it's a fairytale ending to one of the greatest underdog stories in sporting history. But he's not done with football yet, and the search for his new club begins. As speculation mounts, the Vardys consider offers from clubs all wanting to sign the 38-year-old striker. But none are in England, which forces the family to consider: would they go with Jamie, or stay at home? On deadline day, there is last-minute chaos as Jamie decides between two top clubs, one in Holland and the other in Italy. At the eleventh hour, he takes the Italian job. The Vardys are going to Italy! Determined to stay together as a family unit, Becky flies to Italy to find a house and schools for the kids - but in rainy Milan, nothing goes to plan.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin starts his American adventure with a visit to one of his favourite places in the USA - the Napa Valley. He first drops into one of the best food and drink markets in California before cooking with some delicious local produce at a stunning vineyard - James then gets an exclusive look at the brand-new kitchen at The French Laundry, one of the world's best restaurants, and tours their stunning kitchen garden with chef and owner Thomas Keller. A visit to the Napa Valley wouldn't be complete without blending your own wine, so James makes his own red to bring back home with him - finally, James takes inspiration from Napa's bountiful larder to cook California-inspired food back in the UK.

programme.title: Bob's Burgers
programme.desc: Animated comedy about Bob Belcher, who runs Bob's Burgers restaurant, and his family. programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: At Jamie's final game for Leicester City, he scores his 200th goal for the club - it's a fairytale ending to one of the greatest underdog stories in sporting history. But he's not done with football yet, and the search for his new club begins. As speculation mounts, the Vardys consider offers from clubs all wanting to sign the 38-year-old striker. But none are in England, which forces the family to consider: would they go with Jamie, or stay at home? On deadline day, there is last-minute chaos as Jamie decides between two top clubs, one in Holland and the other in Italy. At the eleventh hour, he takes the Italian job. The Vardys are going to Italy! Determined to stay together as a family unit, Becky flies to Italy to find a house and schools for the kids - but in rainy Milan, nothing goes to plan.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks...
programme.desc: Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in Italy's Deep South, meeting producers who are as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them. In his bespoke, vintage food truck he discovers traditions behind chillies in Calabria and the connection between the UK and Puglia's grapes. After stopping off in the dramatic city of Matera, Tom arrives in stunning Calabria just as a chilli festival is getting underway. Joining the celebrations alongside the Chilli King, he gets stuck into the local cuisine and learns about the deep emotional connection between this region and product. To contribute to the festivities, he cooks up a Calabrian chilli, butterbean and sausage stew. His journey then takes him to Puglia, where he discovers a farm that spearheaded the UK's love of grapes back in the 60s by developing a series of ice factories at train stations. After a hard day's work, Tom cooks a dish that puts the fruit front and centre: pork fillet with pickled grape and pine nut dressing.

programme.title: James Martin's American Adventure
programme.desc: James Martin starts his American adventure with a visit to one of his favourite places in the USA - the Napa Valley. He first drops into one of the best food and drink markets in California before cooking with some delicious local produce at a stunning vineyard - James then gets an exclusive look at the brand-new kitchen at The French Laundry, one of the world's best restaurants, and tours their stunning kitchen garden with chef and owner Thomas Keller. A visit to the Napa Valley wouldn't be complete without blending your own wine, so James makes his own red to bring back home with him - finally, James takes inspiration from Napa's bountiful larder to cook California-inspired food back in the UK.
